series.title: FIH Pro League - India men: league standing by season
series.description: India men's FIH Pro League position, record and points per season in the FIH feed.
series.notes: Lower position is better (9 teams, 16 matches each in a full season). Pro League points: 3 regulation win, 2 shootout win, 1 shootout loss. The feed's Won/Drawn/Lost and shootout columns are not consistent across seasons (e.g. men 2025-26: 4W+5D+7L=16 with 2 shootout wins and 19 pts; men 2023-24: 5W+0D+5L plus 3 SO wins and 3 SO losses), so Position/Played/Points are authoritative. 2020-21 men played only 8 matches (COVID-affected). Seasons in which India is absent from the FIH feed are skipped.

series.title: India men hockey: top scorers, current vs past players (goals in FIH-recorded matches)
series.description: The 6 highest goal-scorers among India men players still in the national squad and the 6 among those who have moved on, using career totals on their FIH player profiles.
series.notes: Current = the player has India appearances recorded in an FIH competition that ended in the last 24 months (since 2024-11-10); past = anyone else who was in an India squad for a Pro League, World Cup, Olympic Games or 2026 Asian/qualifier event listed in the FIH feeds. Goals are the career total on the FIH player profile (competitions FIH has recorded, mainly since the 2010s) so they understate the full careers of older players. Caps are senior caps from the same profile. Only players who appeared in squads of those FIH events are considered, so players who retired before the FIH squad feeds start are not covered. Ranked by goals; the second dataset is shown for context.
